figures.title: BPE merge trace: lowest
figures.caption: Pair counts and rank order decide the merge. Rank 0 merges l o, rank 1 merges lo w, rank 2 merges low with the end-of-word marker, and rank 3 merges low e. The final pieces for lowest are lowe, s, t, and the end-of-word marker.
figures.alt: A corpus of low, lower, and lowest starts as individual symbols. Pair counts show l o and o w at 8 occurrences, then lo w at 8, low with the end marker at 5, and low e at 3. Four merge ranks rewrite the corpus in order; after rank 3 the final pieces are lowe, s, t, and the end-of-word marker.

figures.title: GPT-2's 50,257-token vocabulary
figures.caption: GPT-2's vocabulary decomposes exactly into 256 base byte tokens, 50,000 learned merges, and one end-of-text marker. The rows are schematic because 256 and 1 would be invisible beside 50,000; the counts are exact.
figures.alt: Three rows: 256 base byte tokens, 50,000 learned merges, and one end-of-text marker. A bracket labels the total 50,257, and the arithmetic 256 + 50,000 + 1 = 50,257 is printed below.
